title: The Mysterious String
description:
Inside an old communication station, a mysterious device receives strings of letters and responds with answer. The device was discovered without any instructions, and nobody knows how it decides what answer to display.

The rule behind its response is hidden. Study the examples carefully, uncover what the device is doing, and reproduce its answer for any given string.
input_format: The input contains a single string S consisting of lowercase English letters.
output_format: Print a single integer representing the hidden value produced by the system.
constraints:
1 <= |S| <= 100
S contains only lowercase English letters.
